name: @georgepullen/paseo-remote-power
description: Wake and status control for remote machines — homelab boxes, GPU workstations — from the Paseo daemon: roster UI plus embedded MCP tools (power_status, power_wake, power_job_status) so agents can wake a host before running work on it.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && NODE_ENV=test node --import ./tests/register-ts-hooks.mjs --test shared/registry.test.ts server/wol.test.ts server/probe.test.ts server/wake-engine.test.ts server/registry.test.ts index.server.test.ts mcp/test/protocol.test.mjs
